item.title: 3.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
Beta. For testing on one Mac; the final 3.0.0 follows.

  • New look for macOS 27 (Liquid Glass), with a matching look on macOS 15 to 25: sidebar steps Platforms, Files, Review and Convert; Light, Dark or System theme; Cards or List on Platforms
  • New Mosyle export: one Mosyle.xlsx with four sheets (students, teachers, classes, staff). Staff IDs are built from names and can be edited in Review
  • Review step: a sortable, searchable student table with Select all / None, and Teacher / Staff decisions made before converting
  • Convert shows progress and can be cancelled; a failed run leaves no half-written files
  • Settings: Receive beta versions, default folders for each file, and Clean up folder (keeps the latest run, moves older dated folders to the Trash after you confirm)
  • Release Notes page with a tab for each version
  • Runs on macOS 15 or later (Apple silicon and Intel)
  • Clever, Follett-Destiny and Microsoft files are unchanged from 2.1.0
  • The student file must now include the Grade - this year column
